name: Russian A2.1
description: Students expand their basic knowledge of Russian as a foreign language, taking into consideration cultural and intercultural aspects and enabling them to communicate successfully in everyday situations. Students learn/practice: asking for and providing information; talking about plans and intentions and providing brief explanations for them; They practice talking about their preferences, interests and experiences. The course will cover grammatical topics requisite for this level of mastery. Students learn strategies to effectively communicate in everyday situations with minimal language skills.
prerequisites: Sound knowledge of levels A 1.1 and A 1.2; active participation
